changes.new: IWorkSourceDocument.Open(path | stream, IWorkDocumentKind.Numbers, readOptions[, ct]).ToExcel(...) / ToExcelResult(...)
changes.reason: Converters use the shared shape: To{Target}(options[, out OfficeConversionReport], ct), To{Target}Async returning OfficeConversionResult<T>, and SaveAs{Target}(path | stream) returning OfficeConversionReport. Result, Bytes and Stream twins are removed.
changes.replacement: Open the source with IWorkSourceDocument.Open and call ToExcel, SaveAsExcel or ToExcelResult; append RequireCompleteEditableReconstruction() to keep the strict behaviour.

changes.new: IWorkSourceDocument.ToExcel(NumbersExcelExportOptions options[, out OfficeConversionReport report], CancellationToken); ToExcelAsync; SaveAsExcel(path | stream); SaveAsExcelAsync
changes.reason: Converters use the shared shape: To{Target}(options[, out OfficeConversionReport], ct), To{Target}Async returning OfficeConversionResult<T>, and SaveAs{Target}(path | stream) returning OfficeConversionReport. Result, Bytes and Stream twins are removed.
changes.replacement: ToExcel returns partial reconstructions with their report; use ToExcelResult(...).RequireCompleteEditableReconstruction() for the previous strict behaviour.

changes.new: IWorkSourceDocument.ToExcelResult(IWorkConversionOptions options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) : NumbersToExcelResult
changes.reason: The result keeps the source package and the typed source projection, which the common report does not carry, so it stays as a distinct evidence operation.
